raw_estimator_receipt.method: Actual combined Worker system/record messages and clip(); estimated input tokens = JS characters / 3.5; 620 output tokens (existing Qwen bake-off mean, includes thinking); neuronsFor() prices. One call supplies both summary and topics.
raw_estimator_receipt.limitations: Gross marginal USD before shared daily free allowance. Retry rates are scenarios, not measured for this corpus; excludes platform, D1 and KB costs. No generation or queueing performed. Metadata-only relabels may retain existing enrichment; this estimates complete re-enrichment as a conservative scenario.

metadata_repair.notes: Metadata-only PATCH of existing slugs retains summaries/topics. No model enrichment is needed. Usermetadata triggers text/filter re-indexing without extraction processing; expected steady-state net index growth approximately zero, not a measured hosted result. Progress processing charges remain unpriced.

progress.processing_usd_formula: 0.008 * billable Progress platform tokens; conversion from bytes/documents and remaining included usage unknown.
progress.storage_method: Historic 2,000-document pilot: +98.9 MB including briefs, 49.45 decimal KB/document. This cohort already exists; its analogous footprint is not an incremental storage bill.
progress.incremental_index_gb_status: Approximate steady-state source-based estimate, not an observed hosted index_size difference or a byte-exact guarantee.
progress.index_effect_method: Writer marks usermetadata edits for prefilter re-indexing. Index builder replaces text/filter and metadata relation entries for existing IDs; unchanged paragraph/vector entries are not rewritten. Extra is absent from resource index inputs. New segments and deletion records can cause transient growth until merges purge obsolete entries. Label dictionary/posting changes may alter final bytes. Approximately zero net steady-state growth for 49,316 existing resources; no new cohort footprint. Keep shared 5.5 GB ceiling unchanged and observe an approved pilot before extending batches.

source_audit.method: Read-only public source fetches, User-Agent opax-improve-audit, at least 1.05 seconds between request starts, no redirects or retries. No refusals occurred. No production or KB calls. Hosted deployment revision is unverified.

sources.supports: Usermetadata triggers resource re-indexing; extra alone is not a full re-index trigger. Metadata-only payloads with no content fields skip extraction processing.
Commits newly written segments and deletion records together, rather than appending permanent duplicate resource IDs.
Prefilter update replaces text/filter entries for existing field IDs. Extra is absent from resource index inputs at lines 49-67. Vector updates require vectors or deleted splits at lines 455-461.
Regression test asserts equal counts of text entries and deletions, metadata relation replacement, and no paragraph or vector deletions.
Merge policy supports purging deletions; physical segment storage can temporarily grow before compaction.

limits: Metadata-only repair model cost is US$0. Full re-enrichment scenarios are optional, gross marginal USD before shared free allowances, not a total KB bill. No generation, queueing, production read or remote repair was performed. The primary-max-output scenario exceeds the existing cumulative model ceiling. Progress processing fees, contract quotas and transient index growth remain unmeasured. Approximately zero incremental steady-state index GB is inferred from pinned upstream source, not confirmed on the hosted KB; the shared 5.5 GB ceiling remains in force.
